Remaining BST/PUP null-URL scope-source fallbacks corrected by append-only successors (BST bg-ready and PUP bg-maneuver confirmed); engaged-accuracy NIN AM3 citation completed; selections unchanged; all22jobs/DNC and original limitations retained.
